entities.name: Query protein (329 aa)
observations: Sequence length is 329 aa; estimated molecular weight is 36.2 kDa and theoretical pI is 6.08.
Pfam domains Semialdhyde_dh (PF01118) span residues 2–116 and Semialdhyde_dhC (PF02774) span residues 135–310.
Best reviewed homolog is Aquifex aeolicus aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase O67716: 54.9% identity, 99.7% query coverage, E-value 1.4e-117.
Additional reviewed ASADH homologs occur in Legionella pneumophila and Bacillus subtilis at 48.9% and 47.5% identity, respectively, with near-complete coverage.
Likely function is NADPH-dependent conversion of L-aspartyl-4-phosphate to L-aspartate-semialdehyde; exact substrate specificity is inferred from homology.
Reference ASADH proteins are homodimers and cytosolic; direct oligomerization and localization evidence for this query are not experimentally established.

entities.name: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
observations: Reviewed homologs are annotated with EC 1.2.1.11 and GO aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity.
The enzyme participates in the aspartate-family amino-acid biosynthetic branch leading to lysine, methionine, threonine, and related products.
Reference active-site positions include a catalytic cysteine forming an acyl-thioester intermediate and a proton-accepting residue near the C-terminal domain.
